player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I assigned high scores to "Confident" and "Worried" despite the dialogue showing Jamal's confidence was explicitly challenged by Sophia's ultimatum and his own admission of uncertainty ("if it succeeds, it's on me too"). The core dynamic is a clash between rigid control and creative risk, leading to a stalemate where Jamal feels his autonomy is threatened. Next time, I will prioritize "Defiant" as the primary emotion (score 10) because Jamal's final line is a direct, stubborn assertion of his own path in response to Sophia's threat. I will lower "Confident" to 1 (he is no longer confident in the outcome) and "Worried" to 2 (he acknowledges the risk but chooses defiance over fear). "Resentful" remains low (2) as the interaction is more about professional philosophy than personal grievance.
